stages.name: a
stages.query: SELECT __path,ast_kind AS kind,ast_name AS name,ast_alias AS alias,ast_module AS module,ast_value AS value,ast_value_kind AS value_kind,CAST(NULLIF(ast_preorder,'') AS INTEGER) AS id,CAST(NULLIF(ast_breadth_order,'') AS INTEGER) AS bfs,CAST(NULLIF(ast_parent,'') AS INTEGER) AS parent,ast_field AS field,CAST(NULLIF(ast_index,'') AS INTEGER) AS position,CAST(NULLIF(ast_end,'') AS INTEGER) AS last,CAST(NULLIF(ast_function,'') AS INTEGER) AS fn,ast_op AS op,CAST(NULLIF(ast_start,'') AS INTEGER) AS __start,CAST(NULLIF(ast_stop,'') AS INTEGER) AS __end,CAST(NULLIF(ast_line,'') AS INTEGER) AS line,ast_context AS context,ast_name_repr AS name_repr,ast_value_repr AS value_repr,ast_annotation AS annotation,ast_annotation_repr AS annotation_repr FROM canonical

stages.name: functions
stages.query: SELECT * FROM a WHERE kind IN ('FunctionDef','AsyncFunctionDef')

stages.name: methods
stages.query: SELECT f.*,c.name AS class_name FROM functions f JOIN a c ON c.__path=f.__path AND c.id=f.parent AND c.kind='ClassDef' WHERE f.field='body'

stages.name: symbols
stages.query:
SELECT n.*,CASE WHEN n.kind='Attribute' THEN 'attribute' ELSE 'name' END AS label,n.name AS symbol,n.name_repr AS quoted,n.id AS ordering FROM a n WHERE n.kind IN ('Name','Attribute')
 UNION ALL SELECT i.*, 'name',CASE WHEN i.kind='Import' THEN substr(s.name,length(rtrim(s.name,replace(s.name,'.','')))+1) ELSE s.name END,s.name_repr,i.id+s.position*0.001 FROM a i JOIN a s ON s.__path=i.__path AND s.parent=i.id AND s.kind='alias'
 UNION ALL SELECT i.*, 'name',s.alias,''''||s.alias||'''',i.id+s.position*0.001+0.0001 FROM a i JOIN a s ON s.__path=i.__path AND s.parent=i.id AND s.kind='alias' WHERE s.alias!=''
